goal: Turn Dessy's demonstrated homeschool operating schedule into a reusable online-school company while preserving the distinction between private household evidence, public operating structure, products/services, software, legal formation, and external learner outcomes.
next_movement: Decompress the existing learning operation into the first online delivery surface: schedule → curriculum units → learner activity → parent/operator visibility → progress evidence. Preserve the current home-education schedule as operating evidence and do not claim incorporation, accreditation, licensure, public enrollment, or external outcomes until separately witnessed.
walls: Do not publish minor learner identities or individualized private records in the public company layer.
Do not treat the existing homeschool schedule as proof of accreditation, licensure, incorporation, or external customer outcomes.
Do not collapse the company into a single product; products/services are outputs of the company.
Do not overwrite the private household schedule when generalizing the reusable company operation.
